dedupe_keys.name: departement de la seine maritime port and maritime datasets

description: Département de la Seine-Maritime: port and maritime datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département de la Seine-Maritime. Coverage: Département de la Seine-Maritime. The listing groups 8 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about port and maritime; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Ports de Fecamp et du Treport de 2018 à 2024; Carte des IRIS, Communes, EPCI, Cantons, CMS, Groupements de CMS, UTAS; Part et nombre de résidences secondaires en Seine-Maritime (2018 INSEE; Membres du Conseil Départemental de la Seine-Maritime - 20211202. Formats seen: WEB PAGE, CSV, ZIP, GEOJSON, KML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
